title: Local Label Admitted Set
description: Strict admission contract for the per-cell ground-truth labels written to data/local_labels/label_admitted.json by tools/local_labels/repeatability_aggregator.py. Each entry in cells must carry the runner-joinable 7-field key (slug, shape_point, binary_sha256, source_commit, kernel_signature_sha256, arch, ncu_metric_version), the runner-consumed cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct value, the n_repeats / stddev_l2_sector pair, the evidence_kind classifier (live | synthetic), and the schema_version=5 const pin. additionalProperties:false at every layer enforces the wire contract: any unknown field is a contract break. The 4->5 bump adds the optional per-cell unit_tagged_metrics block (non-percentage count/ns/cycles families) in lockstep with the committed metric registry and the sidecar schema's 1->5 bump; the earlier 3->4 bump added the nullable cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct field plus the required l1tex_label_status enum so the layer-aware comparison runner can compute per-arch L1 relative error alongside L2. A schema_version 4 record fed to a v5 consumer is rejected with typed reason local_label_admitted_v5_migration_required; a v3 record (missing the L1 mean field AND the l1tex_label_status enum) is rejected with local_label_admitted_l1_mean_migration_required, forcing the operator to re-aggregate.

schema_version.description: Pinned at 5. The 4->5 bump adds the optional per-cell unit_tagged_metrics block (non-percentage count/ns/cycles label families and the L1 read-hit pct) carried in lockstep with the committed metric registry and the sidecar schema's 1->5 bump; the percentage hit-rate path (cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct / cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct) is unchanged. The const pin is a hard parse-time boundary: a schema_version 4 record fed to a v5 consumer is rejected (a v5 consumer surfaces it as local_label_admitted_v5_migration_required), and a v5 record fed to a pre-v5 consumer is likewise rejected. The earlier 3->4 bump added the nullable cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct + required l1tex_label_status enum (v3 records rejected as local_label_admitted_l1_mean_migration_required).

cells.description: List of admitted-cell records. The aggregator emits one entry per (arch, slug, shape_point) cell that survives the repeatability and provenance gates.

schema_version.description: Per-record pin to keep stale-shape records from creeping in via raw concatenation. Bumped 4->5 in lockstep with the file-level schema_version.

evidence_kind.description: Classifier for the cell's evidence provenance. "live" denotes records produced from a real NCU sweep (the only path the aggregator emits); "synthetic" denotes records authored by test fixtures and intended to exercise the wire format without standing in as evidence. The comparison runner's live-only floor counts only cells with evidence_kind == "live"; synthetic cells declare their nature explicitly so they cannot accidentally satisfy the smoke-test floor.

slug.description: Kernel slug from the workload roster (e.g. gemm_hmma_bf16_sm80). One leg of the 7-field join key.

shape_point.description: Shape-file row identifier the cell ran with.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel binary used in this cell's measurement run.

source_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD at the time of the NCU collection invocation. Captured by the per-launch label_run_manifest_<repeat>_<launch>.json.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: Stable per-kernel hash sha256(slug|binary_path) mirroring run_suite.py::_kernel_signature_sha256.

arch.description: Compute capability tag of the local device. CLAUDE.md's Two-Device Local Development Model pins the local arch set to sm_86 (RTX 3090 Ti) and sm_120 (RTX 5060 laptop); cross-arch admission is one-arch-at-a-time.

ncu_metric_version.description: Pinned protocol version for the NCU metric semantics. Mirrors workloads/simbench_bw/comparison_contract.toml's ncu_metric_version field. A non-pinned value is a contract break, not a configuration.

profiler_version.description: Normalized profiler version. The aggregator folds any raw NCU 2026.1.<patch>(.<build>) banner to this pinned form; raw forms outside the family produce label_profiler_version_drift before the cell ever reaches the schema validator.

cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct.description: Mean L2 sector hit rate across the cell's repeats, expressed as percent in [0, 100]. The comparison runner consumes the percent form; the aggregator multiplies the per-repeat fraction by 100 at emission time.

cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct.description: Mean L1/TEX sector hit rate across the cell's repeats, expressed as percent in [0, 100], OR null when the per-repeat sidecars did not carry a cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector value (or carried it for fewer than the minimum needed for a cohort-wide mean). Nullability is required so cells migrating from v3 can declare L1 absence without spoofing a value; the paired l1tex_label_status field declares WHY the value is null when null. The conditional allOf arms below enforce status-vs-value consistency.

l1tex_label_status.description: Closed-enum L1 label status. mean_present: cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct is a non-null number aggregated from at least one per-repeat L1 value AND at least one per-repeat L1 value was non-zero. mean_absent_label_missing: the per-repeat sidecars exist for this cell but did not contain a usable cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector field for any repeat (the label collection path did not capture L1). mean_absent_provenance_missing: the cell's per-repeat provenance is missing (no usable sidecars) so neither L1 nor L2 mean can be derived from sidecars; status is set only for fail-closed migration records that the aggregator could not re-aggregate without re-running the NCU sweep. all_zero: every per-repeat L1 value WAS captured but each was exactly 0.0 (cell exercises the L1tex hardware path but does not produce sector hits, e.g., vendor_sgemm_cublas/timing_shape whose cublas-backed kernel bypasses the L1tex cache pipeline); cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct is the non-null number 0.0 and stddev_l1tex_sector is also 0.0; the runner consumes the cell normally for L2 prediction and emits a per-cell diagnostic noting the L1tex zero distribution. The comparison runner emits typed reason comparison_runner_l1tex_label_mean_missing for any cell whose status is one of the two mean_absent_* values before any L1 join fires; the L2 join continues normally.

n_repeats.description: Number of distinct repeat indices that contributed to this admitted cell. The repeatability_aggregator gates a cell on N >= 5 repeats.

stddev_l2_sector.description: Sample standard deviation of the per-repeat L2 hit-rate values (fraction units). Bounded above by the contract's pinned stddev_threshold = 0.03; cells exceeding the threshold are excluded with label_repeatability_failed before reaching this schema.

stddev_l1tex_sector.description: Sample standard deviation of the per-repeat L1/TEX hit-rate values when present, else null.

register_cap.description: Optional register-cap build-variant axis value (the per-thread -maxrregcount cap for a register-spill build variant). Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; base cells (no build variant) omit it and remain valid. Present only for build-variant cells and paired with variant_id. No schema_version bump because the addition is purely additive per the CLAUDE.md wire-extension policy.

variant_id.description: Optional build-variant identity component of the cell key (e.g. register_cap_64). Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; base cells omit it. When present it widens the canonical cell identity from (arch, slug, shape_point) to (arch, slug, shape_point, variant_id) so two build variants of the same shape are distinct admitted cells. Paired with register_cap. The pattern pins the CANONICAL decimal form (no leading zeros, e.g. register_cap_064 is rejected) so one physical cap cannot be admitted under two aliases; the aggregator's _variant_identity normalizer already fails such aliases closed before emission, so this output-side pattern is a belt-and-suspenders invariant. No schema_version bump (purely additive per the CLAUDE.md wire-extension policy).

source_commit_override_from.description: Optional audit-annotation field carrying the pre-refresh source_commit SHA when a cell's source_commit was rewritten (e.g., via tools/local_labels/refresh_admitted_label_source_commit.py). Purely additive: NOT in 'required'; legacy cells that never needed the override remain valid; admitted cells that DID get refreshed pin the original SHA for audit traceability. Admission preserves additionalProperties:false on every other field; no schema_version bump because the addition is purely additive per the CLAUDE.md wire-extension policy.

source_commit_refresh_history.description: Optional audit-annotation field listing the immediate-prior source_commit SHA across each refresh cycle (appended on every non-no-op call to tools/local_labels/refresh_admitted_label_source_commit.py). Complements source_commit_override_from (which pins the ORIGINAL pre-refresh origin and is set only once on the first-ever refresh) by recording the IMMEDIATE prior of each subsequent refresh. Purely additive; NOT in 'required'; legacy cells without any refresh history remain valid. Added after review identified that an existing override_from could mask the immediate-prior across multiple refreshes.

unit_tagged_metrics.description: Optional v5 block of aggregated non-percentage label families (count / ns / cycles) and any non-flat-field pct family, one record per admitted target metric that survived its per-unit repeatability gate. ABSENT on cells that carry only the historical fraction hit-rate fields (backwards-compatible: the 4->5 migration stamps schema_version without adding this block). The percentage hit-rate path (cache_hit_rate_l2_sector_pct / cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct) is unchanged and never appears here. The item schema is inlined (not a $ref) so the admitted_cell sub-schema validates standalone.

ncu_metric.description: Canonical Nsight Compute identifier; resolves to a registry entry.

unit.description: Per-metric unit tag; equals the registry unit for this ncu_metric.

value.description: Across-repeat mean in native unit (fraction in [0,1] for pct; non-negative raw count/ns/cycles otherwise).

dispersion.description: Across-repeat dispersion measured by repeatability_rule; within the rule's threshold or the cell is excluded before reaching this schema.

repeatability_rule.description: Which per-unit repeatability rule gated this metric.

n_repeats.description: Number of repeats that carried a usable value for this metric.

allOf.description: Per-cell status-vs-value consistency arm A: l1tex_label_status=mean_present requires cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct to be a number (NOT null). A record declaring mean_present with a null L1 mean is a contract break.

Per-cell status-vs-value consistency arm B: cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct=null requires l1tex_label_status to be one of the two mean_absent_* values. A record declaring a null L1 mean with status=mean_present is a contract break.

Per-cell status-vs-value consistency arm C: l1tex_label_status of mean_absent_label_missing or mean_absent_provenance_missing requires cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector_pct=null. A record declaring an absent status with a non-null L1 mean is a contract break.
